label: CJEU C-604/22 — IAB Europe (TC String, joint controllership)
body: Holding: The TC String generated by the IAB Transparency and Consent Framework is personal data under GDPR Art. 4(1) because it can be combined with an IP address or similar identifier to single out a user. IAB Europe is a joint controller for the recording of consent signals — it determines purposes and means by setting the TCF rules, even though it does not directly store or access the signals.

Why it matters: Reinforces the broad joint-controllership doctrine for industry frameworks. Any organisation operating a standard that other parties use to signal consent / record preferences should expect to be classified as a joint controller for those flows.
UK status: Decided 7 March 2024 — after the end of the Brexit transition period — so NOT assimilated law and not binding on UK courts or the ICO; persuasive authority only under the UK GDPR.
